rules: One platform-owned operation identity and queue; modules may not create incompatible generic retry queues.
Revalidate purpose, authority, scope, disclosure, destination, credential state, and schema before replay.
Resolve ambiguous outcomes before blind retry when duplicate external consequences are possible.
Never claim exactly-once delivery solely because an idempotency key exists.
Never persist raw credentials or retain sensitive payloads indefinitely by queue default.
Background Sync may accelerate replay but is never required for correctness.
An interrupted IN_FLIGHT operation is promoted to OUTCOME_UNKNOWN and RECONCILE before an executor is allowed to run it again.
RECONCILE uses a distinct adapter port; without one, the operation remains visibly RECONCILE and is never silently replayed.
FAILED_RETRYABLE outcomes persist bounded exponential backoff and retryCount; reaching maxAttempts becomes FAILED_TERMINAL with explicit evidence.
The shipped Recovery staging path performs no network request; explicit execution may consider only the exact persisted destination selected by the configured adapter.
An executor OUTCOME_UNKNOWN is persisted and promoted to RECONCILE before any subsequent reconciliation attempt; it is never converted into a blind second execution.

New user-created effects persist authority, permission, optional Space, disclosure class, and payload schema; explicit replay revalidates that context and cancels before executor use when it is no longer current.
Contextless pre-contract operations remain readable for compatibility but are not evidence of fully revalidated replay and require explicit migration or requeue before qualification.
qualification: State-machine, crash, revocation, duplicate, expiry, and reconciliation tests required before any external effect ships.
